matches.quote: Since the paper's own conclusion is that the frequencies are "highly sensitive" to charge transfer, this choice directly affects the comparison... report how the pocket areas change
Add compositional data: EDX/WDX on cleaved crystals... Add Raman spectra... Quantify the residual graphite and any mixed-stage fraction seen in Fig. S1.
The main text nevertheless says the RuCl3 layer remains "rather insulating" (p. 5)... repeat at least the stage-2 and one stage-4 geometry in GGA+SOC+U with zigzag (or ferromagnetic) order
The Hall data were measured... but are not shown. They give the carrier sign and density, which can be checked against the Luttinger count of the observed pockets.
A control is needed to show that the high-frequency pocket comes from RuCl3 intercalation and not from chlorine doping... Quantify the residual graphite and any mixed-stage fraction
The assignment of SdH frequencies to specific DFT pockets rests on one adjustable Fermi-level shift and leaves several mismatches... the agreement does not discriminate between models.
no measurement probes the RuCl3 layers' magnetism... Nor does any measurement probe flat bands or correlated behaviour of the graphene blocks

notes: C5 is judged partly raised because the review asks for Raman, EDX/WDX, sample dimensions, and mixed-stage fraction, but not STEM or spatial uniformity imaging. C7 and C8 are judged partly raised via P7/P17, which critique how transferred electrons are accommodated in alpha-RuCl3 (spurious metallic Ru t2g in non-magnetic GGA vs insulating GGA+U+SOC) and ask how this affects the magnetism and calculated SdH pocket areas, though without specifically framing it around Cl-orbital localization. C6 is not raised because P14 only discusses artificial supercell strain in the DFT models rather than physical intercalation-induced strain and Kitaev interactions. In P14, the factor-of-2 difference in Bader charge arises because the honeycomb alpha-RuCl3 primitive cell contains two RuCl3 formula units, though the strain/bond-length inconsistencies noted in P14 are valid.
